basic_info.description: Set above the street with sweeping views and a sunlit deck off the newly renovated kitchen, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home blends charm, functionality, and style in all the right ways. Thoughtfully expanded by its current owner, the lower level now includes a fully permitted bedroom and bath - ideal for guests, a home office, or quiet retreat.     The layout feels just right: bright, connected, and designed for everyday living. A private hot tub, large garage, and updated systems - including solar (!) make life easy, while warm finishes and thoughtful details give the home a welcoming feel. Moments from Bernal Heights Parkwhere locals head for views, dog walks, and morning runsand close to Cortland's shops and cafes, 574 Peralta is that rare home that delivers on every front.
